test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__To much__ seriousness __hardens the world, pinning__ it down __with rules__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the phrase **"to much" is incorrect.**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "too much" (intensifier + noun), indicating an excessive amount.**
 
• **"To" **is a preposition, whereas **"too" **means** "excessively"** or** "more than enough," **which suits the context.
 
• **"Too much"** is used to quantify non-count nouns when expressing an excessive amount.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• She had** too much** homework to finish in one night.
 
• He drank** too much **coffee and couldn’t sleep.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is : ***Too much seriousness hardens the world, pinning it down with rules.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Other options are correctly structured:**

 
• **"With rules"** is correct and does not require any rectification.
 
• **"Hardens the"** is grammatically correct.
 
• **"World, pinning" **is correctly punctuated and grammatical.
